required_sections: Questions only a human can answer
notes: Structural spec for the `structured` (v2) prompt's output. The structural check mechanically verifies these section headings are present and that each finding names the required *invariants* — Observation, Interpretation, Next investigation. Oracle, Risk and Status are deliberately OPTIONAL in the prompt ('when useful'), so they are not required here: requiring them would turn testing into checklist completion. This is a presence/conformance check only — POST-PROCESSING, never a judgment of quality. The human is the sole judge.
